name: doo-lights-sd
description: doo-lights.w3x (make-doo-lights.mjs: flat.w3x, doo version 13, 17 doodads whose models have lights and controls) opened and saved after an empty edit, SD (branch fix/doo-light-extras, 2026-11-23). The editor's save gives each doodad or destructable with extras [] one block per light of its variation's model: [index, 0, 0xFFrrggbb, intensity, shadow casting start, end, quadratic, linear falloff, damping], the light's fixed values (YOlp and LObz: intensity 0 under a KLAI track), the colour times 255 cut down (YOlp 0xFFFFF79E), two lights two blocks (YOf1, the destructable DTs0); the custom LightA.mdx's own values (shadow start 30, end 90, quadratic 0.002, linear 0.03, damping 0.0004; attenuation, ambient and shadow intensity unused), the version-800 text model LightB.mdl its colour reversed and 0, 0, 0.0005, 0, 0.00001; lights of the doodad's own kept, the tree and the barricade keep []. Studio (dooversion.ts lightBlocks, the terrain view's save): D001 now read from the .mdl (branch fix/doodad-mdl-only; needs a we-compare run)
